details.description: Voxtral Small is Mistral AI's audio-input model for instruct use cases, released July 15, 2025 under the Apache 2.0 license as an audio-capable version of the Mistral Small 3.1 backbone. 'voxtral-small-latest' is Mistral's always-current API alias for this model, and Mistral's own model card lists it alongside 'voxtral-small-2507' as the version it currently resolves to. It transcribes speech with automatic language detection, answers questions about audio and summarizes it directly without a separate speech-recognition pipeline, and supports function-calling triggered from voice input. Mistral's model card marks it generally available (GA) with a 32K-token context window.
advantages: Mistral reports it comprehensively outperforms OpenAI's Whisper large-v3 on transcription, beating GPT-4o mini Transcribe and Gemini 2.5 Flash across tasks (Mistral AI Voxtral blog).
Mistral reports state-of-the-art results on English short-form transcription and on Mozilla Common Voice, and that it outperforms Whisper on every FLEURS multilingual task (Mistral AI Voxtral blog).
Listed as generally available (GA), not preview, on Mistral's own model card (Mistral AI Voxtral Small model page).
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, permitting open commercial and research use (Mistral AI Voxtral Small model page; Mistral AI Voxtral blog).
disadvantages: Mistral documents strong performance for eight named languages (English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Hindi, German, Dutch, Italian) without giving a fuller list (Mistral AI Voxtral blog).

Mistral's comparisons against Whisper, GPT-4o mini Transcribe and Gemini 2.5 Flash are its own reported results, not an independent third-party leaderboard for this exact model (Mistral AI Voxtral blog).
use_cases: High-accuracy speech transcription with automatic language detection (Mistral AI Voxtral Small model page; Mistral AI Voxtral blog).
Voice-based question answering and audio summarization (Mistral AI Voxtral blog).
Triggering function calls or backend workflows directly from voice input (Mistral AI Voxtral blog).

notes: Confirmed via Mistral's own model-card page (raw HTML) that the alias 'voxtral-small-latest' is listed together with 'voxtral-small-2507', i.e. it currently resolves to the same July 2025 release already covered under the catalog's separate 'voxtral-small-24b-2507' entry (Bedrock/Hugging Face use the '24B-2507' name; Mistral's own API uses '2507'/'latest'). Catalog facts (32,768 max input and output tokens) match Mistral's own 32K context-window figure exactly, so no conflict to flag here.
